notes.title: GRUNND Soundtrack - beautiful, marvelous, one of the kind!
notes.content:
UK based composer Ed Watkins has bestowed upon our mere mortals this beautiful soundtrack. It has "GRUNND" written all over it. 

Ed, I am so happy we have met. I could even call you Sir Edward [which would be weird, because it's not your name] for such a great job and understanding.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2357370/GRUNND_Soundtrack/]Click here to get right to it![/url]

As a developer of GRUNND, I have to say - this Soundtrack has a better build quality - no bugs, no glitches.

I dedicate this release to Melnis, who passed away this morning. He was twenty summers old warrior. I love you, Melnis.

- Olafs

[img]https://i.imgur.com/z2mxbJJ.jpg[/img]

notes.title: And here comes another version update - v1.017!
Besides everything some EXTRA FILES are coming in
notes.content:
Many of you have enjoyed in-game soundscape composed by marvelous Ed Watkins. And, trust me, you can listen it as a separate thing very well. I know I do! 

Thus the fork on music compilation have begun. No dates yet.

Also, the ArtBook! Great visuals accompanied with Protagonist's notes about his journey. Some [really - just "some"] secrets might be revealed. Well, maybe at least, made cleared.

And - yes - all yer regular fixes as well.

- Olafs

notes.title: Like GRUNND? Please, leave a REVIEW!
notes.content:
A lot of lessons learned. And I am more than confident that second part of the Trilogy will be bigger and better. Less hick-ups, more atmosphere, story and, well, mystery. 

One of the things publishers look on are the reviews. I am so, SO thankful for reviews already left - they are amazing, lovely and I am giving high-five to every one of the authors [yes, also to the negative ones]. 

Unfortunately it's a number game and the more we have of good stuff the better. So, please, if you liked GRUNND, leave a review - even a shortest one.

P.S. We are slowly starting to test Mac and Linux versions.  It's not a fast process, but we're on the way.

Thank you,

- Olafs @ GRUNND

Also updated Ending a bit, and some small fixes I don't even remember. Should've written those down.

Also yesterday sent out keys to our BETA testers, who participated in testing during December.

Update the installation!

We will play through the Demo and I will make stops just to ramble about relevant stuff you see.

- Olafs

notes.title: Good times are here!! [Partnership, SteamNextFest, ramble]
notes.content:
Let's keep it short.

We successfully reached the Kickstarters goal. Thank you all who supported GRUNND and gave it a start. A start of the road past the Demo, which was so lovingly created. And by "lovingly" I mean "with love and dedication, despite so many hurdles and mountain of new grey hair".

The fast was, that the Kickstarter funding was not enough to deliver the game in it's fullest. Yes - our inner goal was a bit different. Now I can surely point to couple mistakes and/or mishaps, and/or failed hopes which influenced this. AnYhOo - it was a question whether to make a shortened version of GRUNND, refund the money or get help.

And we got help! I did a cloudy announcement about it via Kickstarter a while ago, but without mentioning names. Now, today - I can do that fully! 

We, SEKTAHOUSE [the name "Neoteric Rites" was dropped due to copyright issues during registration] have partnered up with great new outfit called [url=https://brightgambit.com/]Bright Gambit[/url]. They are small private investment initiative with diverse and complementary experience in many aspects of the industry. They helped us in more than one way and will continue to do so till GRUNND's world domination. Good guys, yey!

By the way - they do an announcement today as well. [url=https://brightgambit.com/blog/]CLICK HERE[/url] to see who they are and what projects they support already!

GRUNND is coming out this year. Late this year. But we figured out, this summer's SteamNextFest is the right place to start off. Thus you are all very invited to our first ever LIVE broadcast soon, during SteamNextFest, on Thursday, June 16th.

As always - everyone is welcomed to play the Demo and reach out!

All the best,

- Olafs @ GRUNND

Slava Ukraini!

- changed Camera Update to Fixed - this might prevent of camera being stuck outside the intended game window.

Known Issues
- AVG Antivirus is throwing false positive on game's executable. It's a known issue for a lot of games [apparently] - just define the .exe as exception withing AVG. Nothing we can do here.

Upcoming UPDATE 1.0.71
- working on correct loading in when the game has been Exited and then continued via Continue button within Main Menu.
